avoid_dishes.dish: Injera, if it's a wheat/barley blend
avoid_dishes.reason: Many restaurants blend teff with wheat or barley to cut costs

name: Gursha
questions: Is your injera 100% teff, with no wheat or barley flour?
Is it made in-house, or bought in?
Are you still open at Club Vista Mare?
Do any stews use flour or a niter kibbeh made with wheat?

safe_dishes.dish: Injera with stews (doro wat, minced beef, kale with beef)
safe_dishes.note: 2018 reviews call the injera gluten-free, but neither confirms 100% teff

summary: Two 2018 reviews describe the injera as gluten-free, but nothing confirms 100% teff and the evidence is 8 years old, so check it's still open.
